definitions.NO_WALL_r2: NO_WALL macro_r2 > 0 and NO_WALL bootstrap95 lower bound > 0
definitions.WALL_r2: WALL macro_r2 > 0 and WALL bootstrap95 lower bound > 0
definitions.WALL_time_confound_gate: WALL training-time-baseline macro_r2 restricted to tau 1..15 <= stage2_policy.readout.training_only_time_baseline_macro_r2_tau_1_to_15_maximum

best_k_gates.derivation: Obtained by executing stage2_backend.best_k_qualification_checks. The four authority booleans expand to six gates because the two per-scene rules are applied to WALL and NO_WALL separately.

bootstrap_procedure.resample_population: the per-trajectory R-squared values, ordered by trajectory identity ascending

estimands.error_derivation: scalar_metrics: the unweighted mean of per-trajectory RMSE in world blocks. Reported by stage2_backend.summary as rmse_blocks.
estimands.primary_derivation: regime_a_first25_analysis.scalar_metrics: the unweighted mean of per-trajectory R-squared, each computed against that trajectory's own mean. Trajectory-equal, never row-pooled.

promotion.derivation: Every rule below already governed the Stage-2 readout at c9aad3e324c03c94a08222f4705c18b1a80e3a63; none of them was reachable from frozen authority, so a completed Stage-2 decision could not have been reproduced without reading source. K_GRID and ALPHAS are imported from mineocclude.regime_a_first25_analysis rather than typed; the six BEST-K gate names are obtained by executing stage2_backend.best_k_qualification_checks; the inner-fold shape is obtained by executing regime_a_first25_analysis.inner_fold_assignment. No numeric value is chosen here.
promotion.why_not_in_authority_parameters_json: The completed v0.4 Stage-1 decision d00d7730 binds the bytes of authority_parameters.json (52b9590b), the historical re-derivation compares against that same file, and require_stage2_authorization refuses a Stage-1 decision whose authority digest is not the live one. Editing those bytes would have made the frozen Stage-1 PASS both irreproducible and unusable as the predicate for Stage-2 authorization. This document is bound by the Stage-2 locked manifest instead, which nothing frozen binds yet.

readout_procedure.feature_standardization: fit on each training split only

inner_fold_rule.construction: five deterministic direction-stratified folds. Identities are ordered by SHA256 of 'REGIME_A_INNER_FOLD_V1|outer={outer}|{identity}' within each direction, round-robin assigned, with the second direction offset by one fold. A partition whose direction balance prevents five equal folds is rebalanced by one identity, chosen by SHA256 of 'REGIME_A_INNER_REBALANCE_V1|outer={outer}|{identity}'.

outer_fold_aggregation.derivation: Each of the five outer folds contributes out-of-fold predictions for its own held-out trajectories; the five prediction sets are pooled to cover each row exactly once, and the terminal point estimate is then computed over all 25 trajectories by scalar_metrics. Per-fold metrics are never averaged, and no fold is weighted.

readout_procedure.ranking_scope: training rows only, inside every inner and final fold
readout_procedure.target_handling: training-target centering inside the kernel ridge; no target standardization

terminal.claim_boundary_scope: authority_parameters.json scientific_claim_boundary describes the Stage-1 apparatus-qualification rung, whose PASS tests no model activation. This block describes the Stage-2 decoding rung, which does read layer-4 activations. The two are different rungs and neither statement weakens the other.

pass_authorizes.derivation: authority_parameters.json stage2_policy.post_stage2.may_authorize_confirmatory_collection is false and remains binding. A PASS completes this DEVELOPMENT_ONLY rung and nothing else; any later experiment requires its own separate prospective design and authorization.

terminal.pass_meaning: The frozen DEVELOPMENT_ONLY Stage-2 hidden-position decoding experiment satisfied its prospectively frozen Stage-2 decoding criteria, against the matched visible control. It may support the bounded statement that layer-4 activations contain decodable information according to those criteria, on this apparatus, at these paths.

state_semantics.BLOCKED: an operational, provenance, binding, or completeness failure. Never a scientific verdict
state_semantics.FAIL: a legitimately completed Stage-2 analysis in which at least one re-derived BEST-K gate does not hold
state_semantics.PASS: a legitimately completed Stage-2 analysis in which every BEST-K gate, re-derived from bound evidence, holds

time_baseline_gate_bindingness.derivation: best_k_each_scene_rmse_maximum_blocks is 0.15560477763641264 blocks, while the training-only time baseline's trajectory-aggregated RMSE on this design is approximately 0.41360 blocks; any readout clearing WALL_rmse therefore also clears WALL_beats_training_time_baseline. The tau 1-15 time baseline's trajectory-equal macro R2 is approximately -0.18186, already below the 0.1 confound ceiling before any activation is read, so WALL_time_confound_gate is satisfied by the design rather than by the result.
time_baseline_gate_bindingness.forbidden_claim: the decoder independently beat a time or motion baseline
time_baseline_gate_bindingness.permitted_claim: the frozen time-baseline checks were satisfied

time_baseline_procedure.fitting_scope: rows of the outer-training folds whose tau is at or below training_only_time_baseline_training_tau_maximum
time_baseline_procedure.prediction_scope: every row of the held-out outer fold
